resultset.statement: SELECT id, k, (SELECT v FROM t1_inner WHERE t1_inner.k = t1_outer.k) + 1 AS r FROM t1_outer ORDER BY id

-- Contrast: same shape but with a positive-only inner value, to show the -- outer Item_func sees the replaced field value, not a stale subquery. SELECT id, k, (SELECT v FROM t1_inner WHERE t1_inner.k = t1_outer.k AND v > 0) + 1 AS r FROM t1_outer ORDER BY id
